content.user_title: Design compliant email list growth plans
content.value_statement: Email teams need list growth that protects consent quality and deliverability. This skill turns goals, audiences, and channels into a compliant acquisition plan with targets and handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Maps owned, earned, and paid acquisition channels to an audience and growth goal.
Designs lead magnet and signup incentive concepts matched to the offer.
Specifies single or double opt-in capture flows and required consent evidence.
Defines referral loop mechanics, attribution needs, and quality safeguards.
Labels subscriber growth, cost-per-opt-in, and confirmation-rate targets as Estimated or User-provided.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, popups, or form UI.
Does not record final consent records; it prepares candidates for consent-registry.
Does not write confirmation email copy or lifecycle sequences.
Provides compliance guidance, not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Launch a new acquisition program
use_cases.description: Plan channels, lead magnets, consent capture, and measurable growth targets before launching a subscriber campaign.

use_cases.title: Improve newsletter subscriber quality
use_cases.description: Redesign referrals and signup incentives to increase confirmed subscribers without weakening consent or engagement quality.

use_cases.title: Prepare a compliant opt-in handoff
use_cases.description: Document what consent evidence the signup flow must capture before work moves to registry, landing page, and sequence skills.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a basic list growth strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a first subscriber growth plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan how to grow my email list for [audience]. Current signup source is [source]. Goal is [subscriber target] over [period]. Jurisdiction is [location].

prompt_templates.title: Design a lead magnet and opt-in flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for offer and consent planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a lead magnet for [audience] tied to [offer]. Include the signup promise, single or double opt-in recommendation, and consent evidence to capture.

prompt_templates.title: Build a referral loop with targets
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for referral mechanics and measurement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a referral or recommendation loop for my newsletter. Current list size is [size], top signup source is [source], and incentive budget is [budget].

prompt_templates.title: Create a launch-ready acquisition plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a complete handoff plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full list-growth plan for [audience] and [offer]. Include channels, lead magnet, opt-in capture spec, referral mechanics, growth metrics, risks, and next-skill handoffs.

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS team wants 1,000 new trial-focused subscribers in 90 days.
output_examples.output: The plan prioritizes owned content upgrades, partner webinars, and a buyer checklist lead magnet. It recommends double opt-in, source tracking, timestamp capture, and targets labeled User-provided or Estimated.

output_examples.input: A creator newsletter wants a referral program without hurting list quality.
output_examples.output: The plan defines a share mechanic, referral attribution, incentive limits, and safeguards against low-quality signups. It tracks confirmed opt-ins, early engagement, and referral-source quality.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce brand wants a compliant signup incentive for EU visitors.
output_examples.output: The plan separates the incentive promise from consent wording, recommends jurisdiction review, and lists consent evidence for registry handoff. It avoids broad legal claims.

best_practices: Start from the audience promise and make the lead magnet specific to that promise.
Capture consent evidence at signup and route the record to the consent registry.
Compare growth against your own trailing rate instead of generic benchmarks.
anti_patterns: Using vague giveaways that attract low-quality subscribers.
Treating double opt-in as a universal legal rule without checking jurisdiction.
Inventing signup benchmarks when no baseline or data source exists.

faq.question: Does this skill build the signup page?
faq.answer: No. It defines the acquisition strategy and capture-flow requirements, then hands page work to a landing optimizer.

faq.question: Can it write confirmation emails?
faq.answer: No. It can specify the flow need, but confirmation copy belongs to an email creative or sequence skill.

faq.question: Does it support double opt-in planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends single or double opt-in based on quality goals and jurisdiction context.

faq.question: Will it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It gives compliance planning guidance and recommends qualified legal review for jurisdiction-specific rules.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, offer, current signup sources, list size, growth history, and relevant jurisdiction.

faq.question: Can it plan referral programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines referral mechanics, attribution needs, incentives, and safeguards for subscriber quality.
